label: 2nd-3rd copy steps (recall_idx 1-2) of long sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely on the first two steps after the <DEL> output step: recall_idx 1 (input = orig(0), 72% of mass) and recall_idx 2 (26% of mass). Never fires during the original phase or on the delimiter step. Firing rate and magnitude grow with sequence length: rare for L<=6, rate 0.1 at L=9 vs 0.01 at L=3; L=9 holds 60% of mass. The top activations (about 0.06) are all recall_idx 1 at L=9, and the following recall_idx 2 step fires more weakly (0.3-0.7 of max). Input/output token identity has only weak modulation (r, n, d slightly higher), and filtering on vowels or digits does not help. A small tail fires on the last copy steps of L=9 sequences (recall_idx 7-8, about 2% of mass). About 36% of predicted steps are silent, so precision is incomplete.
